body:
Root cause: flashlight_box_boost added one flat brightness value to all 6 faces of a box uniformly (no directionality), and the beam's own additive cone rendered at alpha 0.85, visually dominating and masking whatever lighting sat behind it -- reading as 'a circle on the screen' rather than real light. Fixed with flashlight_face_boost (real per-face N.L term + softened falloff), flashlight_sources_gather (every active same-scene player's flashlight now lights the world for everyone, not just the local viewer -- real multiplayer support), remote players' beam cones now drawn too, and cone alpha cut to 0.16 so it reads as a faint dust hint instead of a dominant sprite. Live-verified via Xvfb before/after screenshots. Commit 09fbf3a.

⚓ ☃
title: Fix flashlight lighting: real per-face N.L wall diffusion + multiplayer
